structured_output.summary: The change implements Array.prototype.concat and the IsConcatSpreadable helper in prototype_concat.rs, following the spec steps 1–7 in order. ToObject, ArraySpeciesCreate, IsConcatSpreadable (Get of @@isConcatSpreadable, ToBoolean, IsArray fallback), LengthOfArrayLike, the 2^53-1 overflow checks (> for the spreadable branch, >= for the single-item branch), HasProperty/Get/CreateDataPropertyOrThrow ordering, and the final Set(length, nextIndex, true) all match the spec. Errors propagate with `?`. No test-specific branches, no hardcoded values, and no made-up returns. The 22 remaining failures are not-implemented errors from unrelated features (Proxy, RegExp, typed arrays, forEach, preventExtensions), which is acceptable.
